en.t: The Tale of Sumiyoshi is an ancient story.

units.source_text: 大意：某中纳言有女三人，其中一人，即住吉姬，已许配内大臣之子。

en.t: In outline, a certain Middle Counselor had three daughters, and one of them, Sumiyoshi-hime, had already been betrothed to the son of the Minister of the Interior.

units.source_text: 但后母虐待她，想擅自把她嫁给一个名叫主计头的七十老翁。

en.t: But her stepmother mistreated her and tried to marry her off on her own authority to a seventy-year-old man named Kazue no Kami.

units.source_text: 幸而此女逃脱，投奔住吉地方的一个尼姑。

en.t: Fortunately, the girl escaped and took refuge with a nun in the Sumiyoshi area.
In the end, everything finally came to a happy conclusion.

units.source_text: 当时的古本今已不传，现存者是后人仿作。

en.t: The old manuscript from that time no longer survives today, and the versions now extant are later imitations.
